title: Learning Next.js
content: Next.js is a powerful React framework that enables features like server-side rendering and static site generation.

title: Routing in Next.js
content: Next.js uses a file-based routing system. Every file created inside the pages or app directory automatically becomes a route.

title: Understanding SSG
content: Static Site Generation (SSG) allows you to pre-render pages at build time, making your website incredibly fast and SEO-friendly.

title: What is Vercel?
content: Vercel is the cloud platform creators of Next.js. It provides an easy way to deploy and scale frontend applications globally.

title: SEO Optimization
content: Next.js offers built-in components like 'next/head' or Metadata API to help you optimize your site for search engines effectively.
